summary: Fact: VNDA's Q3 10-Q, accession 0001347178-26-000002, maintains a valuation allowance against all net deferred tax assets at 2026-09-30 and 2025-12-31. The allowance was recorded in Q4 2025 as a non-cash charge of $113.7 million. A DTA is not cash. No Section 382 dollar limit is stated there.
